en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with market stalls and umbrellas in the foreground and a grand, ornate town hall building with multiple towers and a central dome in the background. Trams, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians populate the square, and multi‑story historic buildings with awnings line the streets. The caption printed at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz, Rathaus."
